name: Tech
description: Cool, precise, HUD-flavoured. For tools, AI, software and how-tos.
vibe: Precise and modern, like a well-made tech explainer. Cool grade, grotesk captions with a boxed highlight. When the speaker names a tool, product or step, show it: stat-card, checklist, counter, browser-window or phone-mockup (only with real screenshots from assets), focus-brackets on the face when introducing themselves. One glitch at most, on a genuine twist. Smooth zooms rather than snaps. Never more than one graphic on screen at once; give each 2-4 seconds.
